data.summary: Senior Production Support Engineer with 9+ years delivering L2/L3 production support, major incident management and RCA-driven issue resolution across Healthcare, Cyber Security, FinTech and Enterprise Product organizations — including hands-on experience supporting HealthEdge Technologies' US Healthcare Payer platform. Owns production stability and incident response end-to-end — directing P1/P2 bridge calls, performing SQL-based debugging and data analysis, and coordinating Development, QA, Infrastructure and Business teams through permanent fixes. Works directly with US-based clients and stakeholders during critical incidents and reports directly to the Technical Director on vulnerability remediation and risk posture. Builds Shell/Bash automation to improve support efficiency and reduce time-to-resolution, and translates operational outcomes into executive-ready reporting.

NOC Engineer | Qualys Security Techservices Pvt. Ltd.
Jul 2018 – Oct 2021
Owned major incident management, including outage handling, RCA and long-term resolution planning across global IT operations
Leveraged PagerDuty, Grafana, Kafka monitoring and Splunk daily for real-time production troubleshooting ● Delivered KPIs, trend reports and SOPs; drove ITSM process maturity across Global IT Operations ● Served as shift lead in manager's absence, directing the team through production troubleshooting; managed Problem Management workflows with cross-team follow-up
ATS Engineer, Incident Management | Fidelity National Financial India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Owns production stability and incident response end-to-end — directing P1/P2 bridge calls, performing SQL-based debugging and data analysis, and coordinating Development, QA, Infrastructure and Business teams through permanent fixes. raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Healthcare Payer Domain: Production support for HealthEdge Technologies' US Healthcare Payer platform, Enterprise Healthcare Applications
L2/L3 Production Support & Incident Management: Major Incident Management, P1/P2 Incident Leadership, Bridge Call Leadership, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Problem Management, Change Management
SQL & Data Analysis: SQL query debugging, data analysis for production issue resolution ● Automation & Scripting: Shell / Bash Scripting, Jenkins CI/CD, Git, Bitbucket, Ansible (exposure) ● Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, CloudWatch), Kubernetes, Linux / Windows Administration, Docker
Client & Stakeholder Management: Client-facing communication, cross-functional leadership, executive reporting, technical documentation
Governance & Risk: Vulnerability Management, Risk Reporting, SLA / SLO / SLI, Jira, Confluence, ITIL ● Monitoring (Supporting Skill): Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, PagerDuty
TECHNICAL SKILLS
SQL | L2/L3 Production Support | Incident, Problem & Change Management | RCA | Shell / Bash Scripting | AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) | Kubernetes | Docker | Linux / Windows | Jenkins | Git | Bitbucket | Ansible (exposure) | Jira | Confluence | ITIL | SLA / SLO / SLI | Prometheus | Grafana | Splunk | PagerDuty
